name: King of Nineveh
overview: The King of Nineveh is a male figure identified as the ruler during the events described in the account of Jonah. His role is specifically noted in Jonah 3:6. No additional tribal affiliation or personal notes are provided in the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The title 'King of Nineveh' simply denotes his position as the monarch of the city of Nineveh. The meaning of the name is straightforward, indicating his royal authority over Nineveh, as noted in Jonah 3:6.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for the King of Nineveh beyond what is mentioned in the account of Jonah. There are no known relatives or connections listed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: The King of Nineveh plays a crucial role in the biblical narrative by responding to Jonah's prophetic message with repentance and humility. His leadership is instrumental in the city's collective turning from sin, demonstrating the power of God's call to repentance even among Gentile rulers. This episode highlights God's mercy and sovereignty over all nations.
